documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th June, 2026

analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a strong business performance for the financial year ended 31st December 2025, driven by revenue growth of 13.27% to ₹84,780.93 lakhs and an improvement in profit before tax to ₹19,853.66 lakhs. The company expanded its operational capabilities through strategic initiatives, including the integration of Von Roll's resin operations in India, implementation of SAP S/4HANA, and scaling up manufacturing for continuous transposed conductor (CTC) demand. Management also progressed on setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, while maintaining a strong focus on industrial safety, sustainability, and operational discipline. Elantas Beck India Ltd. reported a financial performance for the year ended December 31, 2024, with revenue from operations reaching Rs 74,851.31 lakhs and total income at Rs 80,328.39 lakhs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the markets served by the company continue to show strong long-term potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the company responded swiftly to a surge in demand from the CTC (continuous transposed conductor).
demand_outlook.quote: Our manufacturing agility enabled us to respond swiftly to the surge in demand from the CTC (Continuous transposed conductor), scaling capabilities within three months to meet evolving customer requirements.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed new opportunities emerging in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.
demand_outlook.quote: We are also seeing new opportunities emerging in areas such as data centres, BESS, and more sustainable material technologies.

demand_outlook.claim: The management noted that the overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year compared to the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: The overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year, compared the first half.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and obtaining requisite governmental approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹3,087.84 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹ 3,087.84 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of assets relating to the resin and tapes product business from Von Roll (India) Private Limited enabled the company to offer enhanced technology.
capex_expansion.quote: The acquisition of assets relating to the resin and tapes product business from Von Roll (India) Private Limited has enabled your Company to offer more tailored solutions and enhanced technology in the resin and tapes product segment, resulting in higher contribution from the Electrical Insulation Business.

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved by nearly 19 percent compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales quantity increased by 5.92% as compared to the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of sales quantity, there was an increase of 5.92% as compared to the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company commenced manufacturing of 22 new HV resin products at its Pimpri plant as part of localisation.
orders_capacity.quote: Additionally, your Company is progressing towards technology absorption and localisation of the HV resin business in India and has commenced manufacturing of 22 new such products at its Pimpri plant.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a sales volume level of 32,491 mts, representing a 10.74% increase compared to the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Despite the series of challenging extraneous factors, pressure on the rupee, your Company achieved a volume level of 32,491 mts, a 10.74% increase as compared to previous year i.e. 29,339 mts.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share of ₹10 each for the year ended 31st December, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend payout, if approved by members at the AGM, will be ₹594.58 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend pay-out, if approved by the Members in the ensuing AGM, will be ₹ 594.58 Lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: Funding for the purchase of land at Bharuch has been sourced from the company's internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The funding for the said purchase has been sourced from the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the year unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year 2025 unfolded in an environment marked by continued volatility across global supply chains, fluctuations in raw material prices, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
